mapper.sql: t.*, s.name AS award_supplier_name, c.contract_no, o.order_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_tender_supplier ts WHERE ts.tender_id = t.id) AS supplier_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_bid b WHERE b.tender_id = t.id) AS bid_count

FROM scm_tender t LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = t.award_supplier_id LEFT JOIN scm_purchase_contract c ON c.id = t.contract_id LEFT JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = t.order_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.create_by
mapper.select:
SELECT
t.status = #{status}
AND (t.tender_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY t.id DESC
SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit FROM scm_tender_item i LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.tender_id = #{tenderId} ORDER BY i.id

SELECT ts.*, s.code AS supplier_code, s.name AS supplier_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_bid b WHERE b.tender_id = ts.tender_id AND b.supplier_id = ts.supplier_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bid FROM scm_tender_supplier ts LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = ts.supplier_id WHERE ts.tender_id = #{tenderId} ORDER BY ts.id

SELECT t.id, t.tender_no, t.title, t.deadline, t.status, t.open_time, t.remark, t.create_time, CASE WHEN t.status = 'AWARDED' AND t.award_supplier_id = #{supplierId} THEN t.award_supplier_id END AS award_supplier_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_bid b WHERE b.tender_id = t.id AND b.supplier_id = #{supplierId}) AS bid_count FROM scm_tender t JOIN scm_tender_supplier ts ON ts.tender_id = t.id AND ts.supplier_id = #{supplierId} WHERE t.status <> 'DRAFT' ORDER BY t.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_tender SET status = #{to}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}

(#{i.tenderId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.qty}, #{i.requiredDate}, #{i.remark}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO scm_tender_supplier (tender_id, supplier_id, create_time) VALUES
(#{tenderId}, #{s}, NOW())
